clips.title: 欧盟科技主管维尔库宁谈AI主权与对美关系
title_lines: 欧盟科技主管维尔库宁
呼吁加速建设欧洲自主技术能力
title_highlights: 欧盟科技主管维尔库宁

subtitles.en: You have made a call for faster rapid adoption of efforts and measures to boost Europe's sovereign AI and tech capacity.
subtitles.zh: 你呼吁加快采纳措施，提升欧洲主权AI和科技能力。

subtitles.en: Where are we in that journey? How much urgency is there right now in Brussels to get this done?
subtitles.zh: 目前进展如何？布鲁塞尔对此有多紧迫？

subtitles.en: I think now there is a huge demand for the European solutions because now technology is not only about economy.
subtitles.zh: 现在对欧洲解决方案需求巨大，因为技术不仅关乎经济。

subtitles.en: It's very much about our security, our resilience, our geopolitical power as well.
subtitles.zh: 还关乎安全、韧性和地缘政治力量。

subtitles.en: And we have also recognised that Europe has been open for global investors, global businesses.
subtitles.zh: 欧洲一直对全球市场参与者和企业开放。

subtitles.en: But now there is that kind of very global supply chains. They can be also weaponised against us.
subtitles.zh: 但全球供应链也可能被武器化对付我们。

subtitles.en: So we have to really look at what are the critical sectors where we have to build up our own capacity in the same time when we want to work with trusted partners.
subtitles.zh: 因此必须审视关键领域，在合作的同时建设自身能力。

subtitles.en: So like AI, quantum computing, semiconductors, cyber security technologies, all very critical things.
subtitles.zh: 如AI、量子计算、半导体、网络安全等关键技术。

subtitles.en: When do we start to see the material results, though, of that push by you and the team at the Commission?
subtitles.zh: 那么何时能看到你和委员会推动的实质性成果？

subtitles.en: It's true that it's not happening overnight because currently 80% of the technologies is coming outside of Europe.
subtitles.zh: 确实不会一蹴而就，目前80%技术来自欧洲以外。

subtitles.en: So of course it means that we have to really look at what are the critical sectors.
subtitles.zh: 因此，我们必须认真审视哪些是关键领域。

subtitles.en: And now for example in AI, we are investing heavily into infrastructure. So we are building a 19 AI factory.
subtitles.zh: 例如在人工智能领域，我们正大力**基础设施，正在建设19个AI工厂。

subtitles.en: It's really to boost the computing capacity that we can open this up for our startups.
subtitles.zh: 这旨在提升计算能力，向初创企业开放。

subtitles.en: We have 8000 startups in the European Union who are developing and training AI.
subtitles.zh: 欧盟有8000家初创企业在开发和训练AI。

subtitles.en: But the big obstacle for them is that they don't have access to computing capacity.
subtitles.zh: 但他们的主要障碍是无法获得计算能力。
